characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Askeladden is a young, clever, and resourceful boy of slender build. He has unkempt, tousled brown hair and bright, observant eyes. Askeladden often wears simple, rustic clothing— a long-sleeved, earth-toned tunic, with trousers and sturdy boots, appropriate for travel. He carries a large wooden kneading trough, a simple yet significant object, that belongs to his family. Despite his humble appearance, Askeladden exudes a quiet confidence and determination.

characters.name: Askeladdens to brødre
characters.description: The two brothers of Askeladden are taller and sturdier in build than their younger sibling. They have stern facial features with dark hair neatly combed. The brothers wear simple peasant garments - tunics and trousers. Despite their rugged appearance, they are depicted with a hint of arrogance and envy towards Askeladden. Their demeanor is one of cynicism, and they display a lack of attention to their surroundings, unlike their insightful brother.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: The King is an imposing and authoritative figure, dressed in regal attire befitting his status. He wears a golden crown encrusted with jewels and an ornate robe of royal blue and gold, indicating his wealth and power. His expression is dignified, with a wise and discerning gaze. The King's presence in the royal palace sets a tone of grandeur and command.

characters.name: Troldet
characters.description: The Troll is a large, monstrous creature with a grotesque appearance. It has rugged, rocky skin, wild hair, and a menacing expression. The Troll dwells opposite the royal palace and is often seen in its cave-like home. It is surrounded by riches like silver ducks and treasures indicative of its greed and power. The Troll represents a formidable yet ultimately outwitted antagonist in the story.

characters.name: Trolddatteren
characters.description: The Troll's Daughter is a peculiar character, with a surprisingly benign appearance compared to her father. She has long, wild hair and a puzzled expression, wearing simple garments typical of the mountain dwelling. However, she possesses a certain naiveté, making her vulnerable to Askeladden's cleverness. Her role in the story reflects a blend of compliance and innocence.
